english_description: Titanium. Higher melting temperature than most other metals, blocks all air pressure.
chinese_description: 钛,金属固体坚固的材料熔点很高能导电,会吸收中子

english_description: Exotic matter. Explodes with excess exposure to electrons. Has many other odd reactions.
chinese_description: 奇异物质,在电子的轰击下会发出彩虹色的光并产生压力

english_description: Reserved official element slot; never reuse this numeric ID.
chinese_description: 官方保留元素槽位；不得重新使用此数字 ID。
notes: Tombstone mapped to Meson disabler(); preserves save-ID continuity.

english_description: Sparks. Formed by explosions.
chinese_description: 火花,炸药爆炸产生

english_description: Hydrogen. Combusts with OXYG to make WATR. Undergoes fusion at high temperature and pressure.
chinese_description: 氢气,与氧气燃烧产生水,在高温高压下发生聚变

english_description: Soap. Creates bubbles, washes off deco color, and cures virus.
chinese_description: 肥皂,0.5P时产生肥皂泡可以洗去染色肥皂泡在-25℃/248.15k时会凝固

english_description: Black hole, sucks in particles using gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 黑洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生引力吸入物质并升温

english_description: White hole, pushes away other particles with gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 白洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生斥力排斥物质

english_description: Mercury. Volume changes with temperature, Conductive.
chinese_description: 水银,体积随温度变化,可以导电

english_description: Powered breakable clone.
chinese_description: 可控可破坏复制体,激活时和可破坏复制体相同

english_description: Gravity pump. Changes gravity to its temp when activated. (use HEAT/COOL)
chinese_description: 引力泵,激活时改变其万有引力为自身温度值

english_description: Clay dust. Produces paste when mixed with water.
chinese_description: 粘土砂,和水结合时产生浆糊(PSTE)

english_description: WireWorld wires, conducts based on a set of GOL-like rules.
chinese_description: WireWorld线,一种基于另一个名为WireWorld游戏的固体导电元素

english_description: Gravity bomb. Sticks to the first object it touches then produces a strong gravity push.
chinese_description: 引力炸弹,黏在接触的第一个物体上,产生强大的引力推力

english_description: Fighter. Tries to kill stickmen. You must first give it an element to kill him with.
chinese_description: 打手,电脑控制的小人,会通过喷东西来杀死火柴人

english_description: Force Emitter. Pushes or pulls objects based on its temperature. Use like ARAY.
chinese_description: F射线发射器,会沿着电流方向寻找物质并施加力(与ARAY的方向判定规则一样)

english_description: Repels or attracts particles based on its temperature.
chinese_description: 反射极,无需通电,和FRAY一样,根据温度来吸引或推开物质

english_description: Powered version of PIPE, use PSCN/NSCN to Activate/Deactivate.
chinese_description: 可控动力管,P型硅激活时运输,用N型硅则会停止运输,用超导线会反方向运输

english_description: Detector, creates a spark when something with its ctype is nearby.
chinese_description: 探测器,有相同的物质与之接触时产生电脉冲

english_description: Generates damaging pressure and breaks any elements it hits.
chinese_description: 重力炸弹,对碰到它的物质表面产生一个破坏性的压力

english_description: Temperature sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a greater temperature.
chinese_description: 温度传感器,可以用HEAT/COOL来改变自身温度,当周围有温度比它高的物质时会发出电脉冲

english_description: Vibranium. Stores energy and releases it in violent explosions.
chinese_description: 振金,可以储存能量在猛烈的爆炸中释放出来

english_description: Broken vibranium.
chinese_description: 振金粉,粉末状的振金

english_description: Particle Ray Emitter. Creates a beam of particles set by its ctype, with a range set by tmp.
chinese_description: 物质射线发射器,发射一个由其Ctype设置的粒子束,其范围由Tmp设置

english_description: Piston, pushes particles. PSCN extends, NSCN retracts
chinese_description: 活塞,用PSCN激活时变长

english_description: Frame, can be used with pistons to push many particles.
chinese_description: 支架,用于增加活塞一次性推动物质的数量

english_description: Corrosion resistant metal, will reverse corrosion of iron. Excellent conductor.
chinese_description: 金,抗腐蚀(但通电时会受到酸的腐蚀),可以保护铁免受腐蚀

english_description: Tungsten. Brittle metal with a very high melting point.
chinese_description: 钨,脆性金属具有很高的熔点,但不耐压

english_description: Pressure sensor, creates a spark when the pressure is greater than its temperature.
chinese_description: 压力传感器,压力高于其温度时产生火花。

english_description: Protons. Transfer heat to materials, and remove sparks.
chinese_description: 质子,不能穿透绝缘体,虚空,钻石,振金以及墙会清除碰到电脉冲

english_description: Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Solid Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒块,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gas Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒气,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gravitons. Create Newtonian Gravity.
chinese_description: 引力子，会在周围产生额外的牛顿引力场。

english_description: Duplicator ray. Replicates a line of particles in front of it.
chinese_description: D射线发射器,会将沿电流方向对前方的所有粒子

english_description: Ceramic. Gets stronger under pressure.
chinese_description: 陶瓷,受压时熔点增加

english_description: Rapid heat conductor.
chinese_description: 导热体,导热速度比任何其他材料都快

english_description: Sawdust. Floats on water.
chinese_description: 锯末,轻粉末,可以漂浮在水面上

english_description: Polonium, highly radioactive. Decays into NEUT and heats up.
chinese_description: 钋,高放射性,衰变成NEUT并升温

english_description: Refrigerant. Heats up and liquefies under pressure.
chinese_description: 制冷剂,一种淡蓝色气体,在2P或更大压力下液化时加热,反之蒸发时冷却

english_description: Liquid refrigerant.
chinese_description: 液态制冷剂

english_description: Life sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a life higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 生命探测器,当其周围元素Life值高于传感器温度时,产生电流

english_description: Linear detector. Scans in 8 directions for particles with its ctype and creates a spark on the opposite side.
chinese_description: 线性探测器,从8个方向检测粒子,并在相反方向激发导体

english_description: Powdered Silicon. A key ingredient in producing multiple materials.
chinese_description: 硅粉,一种非常闪亮的粉末,像黄金一样导电

english_description: Platinum. Catalyzes certain reactions.
chinese_description: 铂,可以催化某些反应

english_description: Velocity sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with velocity higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 速度探测器,当速度高于传感器温度的粒子在附近时,会生成电脉冲

english_description: Solid, melts into various elements.
chinese_description: 岩石,坚固的材料,CNCT可以堆叠在它上面

english_description: Lithium. Reactive element that explodes on contact with water.
chinese_description: 锂,与水接触会发生爆炸,可用于制造电池

english_description: Resist. Solidifies on contact with photons, is destroyed by electrons and spark.
chinese_description: 光刻胶,遇PHOT固化,会被ELEC和SPRK破坏

english_description: Solidified resist. Blocks pressure and insulates electricity. Liquefies on contact with neutrons.
chinese_description: 固化光刻胶,绝缘,遇NEUT液化,且会反射PHOT

english_description: Caustic base. Corrodes conductive solids and neutralizes acids.
chinese_description: 强腐蚀性碱液，会腐蚀导电固体并中和酸。

english_description: Seeds. Put on sand and add water to grow a tree.
chinese_description: 种子,放在沙子上时浇水会生长树木

english_description: Aluminium: Light conductive aluminium. Melt with magnesium to make ALMG.
chinese_description: 铝：轻质导电金属；与熔融镁混合可制成铝镁合金。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation because the source constructor is missing.
production: Place ALUM then heat it above its melting point before alloying.
uses: Light conductive metal and ALMG feedstock.
hazards: Hot molten metal can melt nearby materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Copper: Excellent conductor. Oxidizes in wet air; melt with tin or zinc for useful alloys.
chinese_description: 铜：优良导体，在潮湿含氧环境中会腐蚀；可与锡或锌熔炼合金。
notes: Adapted to the current API and rebalanced from Cracker COPR.cpp.
production: Place COPR or melt it for bronze and brass feedstock.
hazards: Wet oxygen can slowly corrode it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect corrosion MSCR and reheat it with its stored COPR ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Lead: Dense low-melting lead is a shielding feedstock and has a registered neutron-absorption property.
chinese_description: 铅：低熔点高密度金属，是屏蔽体原料并登记有中子吸收属性。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation because the source constructor is missing.
production: Place LEAD directly or melt it beside SSIL and an active NCRM spark for RSHD assembly.
uses: Shielding feedstock for local neutron paths and RSHD assembly.
hazards: Low pressure tolerance can convert it into scrap; direct absorption still needs runtime verification.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored LEAD ctype, or use molten LEAD in the bounded RSHD assembly.

english_description: Tin: Soft low-melting tin. Combine molten tin and copper to produce bronze.
chinese_description: 锡：柔软的低熔点金属；与熔融铜混合可制成青铜。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation because the source constructor is missing.
production: Place TIN then melt it with copper above 1375 K.
uses: Bronze feedstock with a low melting point.
hazards: Low pressure tolerance can convert it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored TIN ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Nickel: Corrosion-resistant nickel used in stainless steel and nichrome.
chinese_description: 镍：耐腐蚀金属，是不锈钢和镍铬合金的原料。
notes: Renamed from undefined source token NICK; independent implementation.
production: Melt NICL with chromium or steel inputs at the documented temperature.
hazards: High temperature alloying can melt nearby materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Magnesium: Very light magnesium. Burns fiercely in hot oxygen and alloys with aluminium.
chinese_description: 镁：极轻金属，在高温氧气中猛烈燃烧，并可与铝形成轻合金。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation because the source constructor is missing.
production: Melt MAGN with aluminium above 950 K.
hazards: Above 800 K near O2 it can burn and leave hot scrap.
controls: Remove nearby O2 and heat, cool the metal, and contain hot MSCR after ignition.
cleanup: Cool hot material, collect generated MSCR, and reheat valid stored MAGN for recovery.

english_description: Chromium: Hard corrosion-resistant chromium for stainless steel and nichrome.
chinese_description: 铬：耐腐蚀金属，是不锈钢和镍铬合金的关键原料。
notes: Renamed from undefined source token CROM; independent implementation.

hazards: High temperature alloying can melt nearby materials.

cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Cobalt: Heat-resistant cobalt additive for high-temperature tool steel.
chinese_description: 钴：耐热合金添加剂，用于制造高温工具钢。
notes: Renamed from undefined source token COBA; independent implementation.
production: Melt COBT with steel and molybdenum above 2950 K.
hazards: The required temperature is high enough to melt most nearby materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Molybdenum: High-melting molybdenum additive for pressure-resistant tool steel.
chinese_description: 钼：高熔点合金添加剂，用于制造耐压工具钢。
notes: Renamed from undefined source token MLYB; independent implementation.
production: Melt MOLY with steel and cobalt above 2950 K.
hazards: The required temperature is high enough to melt most nearby materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Zinc: Sacrificial zinc protects nearby iron in water and forms brass with copper.
chinese_description: 锌：在水中优先腐蚀并保护邻近铁，也可与铜熔炼黄铜。
notes: Original implementation; no audited source mod provided a zinc element.
production: Melt ZINC with copper above 1375 K.
uses: Brass feedstock and sacrificial protection for nearby iron.
hazards: Water can corrode it into scrap while it protects iron.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect corrosion MSCR and reheat it with its stored ZINC ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Charcoal: Porous charcoal made by heating wood beside a crucible without oxygen.
chinese_description: 木炭：木材在坩埚旁隔绝氧气加热所得的多孔木炭。
notes: WOOD reaction concept only; independent bounded implementation.
production: Heat WOOD at 650 to 873 K beside CRUC without O2 for 60 updates.
hazards: It is flammable and can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove heat and O2, isolate the fuel from FIRE, and stop the CRUC heating cycle.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Coke: Dense coke made from oxygen-starved coal; a controlled carbon source for steelmaking.
chinese_description: 焦炭：煤在缺氧坩埚中炼成的焦炭，是炼钢用的受控碳源。
notes: Original unambiguous design; ambiguous Seppo COCH and COCA were excluded.
production: Heat COAL above 950 K beside CRUC without O2 for 90 updates.
hazards: It is flammable and steelmaking produces hot products.
controls: Remove heat and O2, isolate the fuel from FIRE, and stop the CRUC heating cycle.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Steel: Strong carbon steel made from molten iron, coke and flux.
chinese_description: 钢：由熔融铁、焦炭和助熔剂制成的高强度碳钢。
notes: Reaction concept retained; implementation and balanced recipe are independent.
production: Run the local steel recipe at 1750 K or above.
uses: Base material for stainless and tool steel.
hazards: High pressure can convert it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored STEL ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Bronze: Corrosion-resistant bronze produced from molten copper and tin.
chinese_description: 青铜：由熔融铜和锡制成的耐腐蚀青铜。
notes: Source contained a registry token only; recipe is independently implemented.
production: Melt copper and tin together above 1375 K.
hazards: High pressure can convert it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored BRNZ ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Brass: Machinable brass produced from molten copper and zinc.
chinese_description: 黄铜：由熔融铜和锌制成、便于加工的黄铜。
production: Melt copper and zinc together above 1375 K.
hazards: High pressure can convert it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored BRAS ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Stainless Steel: Stainless steel is an alloy feedstock and can be assembled with molten LEAD and an active NCRM spark into two RSHD shields.
chinese_description: 不锈钢：不锈钢既是合金原料，也可与熔融铅和通电镍铬组装成两份辐射屏蔽体。
notes: Original implementation; Seppo TTSL is titanium steel and was not reused.
production: Make SSIL above 2200 K or assemble it beside molten LEAD and an active NCRM spark at 700 to 1200 K.
uses: High-pressure alloy and nuclear-shield assembly feedstock.
hazards: High pressure or missing spark can leave it unchanged or turn it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate molten lead and spark input, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR or complete the bounded RSHD assembly and cool the shields.

english_description: Nichrome: Nichrome is a bounded resistive heater and active NCRM spark condition for SSIL and LEAD shield assembly.
chinese_description: 镍铬合金：镍铬是有界电阻加热器，也是不锈钢和铅组装屏蔽体所需的通电镍铬火花条件。
notes: Original implementation and electrical heating behavior.
production: Melt nickel and chromium above 2200 K or spark NCRM beside SSIL and molten LEAD at 700 to 1200 K.
uses: Bounded heater and reusable nuclear-assembly condition.
hazards: Repeated sparks heat it toward melting; remove the spark to stop assembly.
controls: Stop incoming sparks and separate the assembly inputs, then cool the heater.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Aluminium-Magnesium Alloy: Light alloy with better pressure resistance than either soft base metal.
chinese_description: 铝镁合金：铝镁轻合金，抗压能力强于两种较软的基体金属。
notes: Original implementation; undefined Seppo MAGX was not copied.
production: Melt aluminium and magnesium above 950 K.
hazards: High pressure can convert it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect pressure-damaged MSCR and reheat it with its stored ALMG ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Tool Steel: High-temperature tool steel made from steel, cobalt and molybdenum.
chinese_description: 工具钢：由钢、钴和钼制成的耐高温工具钢。
production: Melt steel cobalt and molybdenum above 2950 K.
uses: Highest pressure resistance among current metallurgy materials.
hazards: Extreme alloying temperature can melt nearby materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover the material; route supported damaged metals through MSCR.

english_description: Slag: Steelmaking slag is a recoverable by-product; mild CATA and ACID convert it into FLUX and WATR.
chinese_description: 炉渣：炼钢炉渣是可回收副产物；温和条件下催化剂和酸液可将其转为助熔剂和水。
notes: Original process by-product with an explicit production route.
production: Run steelmaking then cool SLAG beside CATA and ACID at 285 to 340 K.
uses: Recoverable steelmaking by-product and flux feedstock.
hazards: Hot slag or missing catalyst leaves the corrosive mixture unchanged.
controls: Stop the furnace and cool it; separate ACID or CATA and leave the leaching window.
cleanup: Recover SLAG into FLUX and WATR under mild containment or cool and physically isolate it.

english_description: Flux: Steelmaking consumes flux into slag while mild catalytic acid treatment or cooled waste stabilization recovers flux.
chinese_description: 助熔剂：炼钢将助熔剂转为炉渣，温和催化酸处理或冷却废物稳定化又可回收助熔剂。
production: Place FLUX beside steelmaking or recover it from SLAG with ACID and CATA at 285 to 340 K or in the complete waste fixture.
uses: Steelmaking input and recovered output of cross-module loops.
hazards: Steelmaking is hot and the recovery routes require corrosive or radioactive containment.
controls: Control heat and pressure; separate ACID or CATA and cool NWST before stabilization.
cleanup: Reuse recovered FLUX in steelmaking or cool and physically recover unused material.

english_description: Industrial Crucible: Refractory crucible material enabling oxygen-starved carbonization and hot melt containment.
chinese_description: 工业坩埚：耐火坩埚材料，可进行缺氧炭化并容纳高温熔体。
notes: Source token CRUC had no constructor; implementation is independent.
production: Place CRUC beside wood or coal before heating without oxygen.
uses: Enables bounded charcoal and coke production.
hazards: Nearby high temperature processing can melt other materials.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Stop heating, cool the CRUC structure, and physically remove trapped feedstock.

english_description: Metal Scrap: Recyclable scrap whose ctype records and restores its source metal when melted.
chinese_description: 金属碎料：可回收金属碎料；ctype 记录原金属，重新熔化后可恢复。
notes: Original compatibility-safe carrier replacing lossy BMTL conversion.
production: Apply pressure to eligible metals or heat scrap above the stored metal melting point.
uses: Recycles damaged metals back into molten feedstock.
hazards: Invalid stored types fall back to iron when reheated.
controls: Keep a valid stored metal ctype, avoid excess pressure, and stop heating to halt recycling.
cleanup: Reheat a valid stored metal into LAVA with that ctype; otherwise isolate and remove the scrap.

english_description: Nutrient Salt: Nutrient salt for local growth and recovered output of biology and four-module waste stabilization.
chinese_description: 营养盐：供局部生长使用的营养盐，也是生态和四模块废物稳定化的回收产物。
production: Place NUTR beside algae or spores with water; recover it from wet HUMS or stabilized waste at the registered windows.
uses: Local nutrient input and cross-module recovery output.
hazards: Simplified biology limits biomass; missing water catalyst or the required waste window leaves recovery inert.
controls: Control temperature moisture spacing fertilizer and companion waste; use STER wet BIOF or PERO for PATH.
cleanup: Stop local feed conditions; recover HUMS or stabilized waste with the registered inputs or physically remove residues.

english_description: Algae: Wet algae consume nutrient and carbon dioxide and release oxygen in a mild temperature window.
chinese_description: 藻类：湿润藻类在温和温区消耗营养盐和二氧化碳并释放氧气。
production: Place ALGA with nutrient water and CO2 at 285 to 315 K.
uses: Local oxygen production and biology loop input.
hazards: PATH can convert nearby algae into pathogen or humus.
controls: Control temperature, moisture, spacing, and local nutrient supply; use STER or wet BIOF for PATH.
cleanup: Stop the local feed conditions and physically remove residues; treat PATH with STER or wet BIOF.

english_description: Mycelium: Mycelium decomposes wet wood into humus and nutrient without global spreading scans.
chinese_description: 菌丝：菌丝在湿润木材旁将其分解为腐殖质和营养盐，不进行全局扩散扫描。

uses: Decomposer that closes the local nutrient loop.
hazards: PATH can convert nearby mycelium into pathogen or humus.
controls: Control temperature, moisture, spacing, and local nutrient supply; use STER or wet BIOF for PATH.
cleanup: Stop the local feed conditions and physically remove residues; treat PATH with STER or wet BIOF.

english_description: Spore: Light spore germinates beside nutrient and water to establish local mycelium.
chinese_description: 孢子：轻质孢子在营养盐和水旁萌发为局部菌丝。
production: Place SPOR with nutrient and water at 285 to 315 K.
hazards: Simplified biology sends the growth input to HUMS.
controls: Control temperature, moisture, spacing, and local nutrient supply; use STER or wet BIOF for PATH.
cleanup: Stop the local feed conditions and physically remove residues; treat PATH with STER or wet BIOF.

english_description: Pathogen: Temperature-limited pathogen infects local biology and can be treated by STER, wet BIOF, or PERO.
chinese_description: 病原体：受温度限制的病原体会感染局部生态，可用消毒剂、湿润生物膜或过氧化氢处理。
production: Place PATH beside algae or mycelium at 285 to 315 K.
hazards: It propagates in its growth window; PERO treatment fails outside 285 to 330 K or beside hot CATA.
controls: Apply STER wet BIOF or PERO, remove hosts, and leave the growth window.
cleanup: Convert PATH to HUMS then recover HUMS with wet FERT or physically remove it.

english_description: Sterilant: Sterilant neutralizes one adjacent pathogen and becomes inert humus.
chinese_description: 消毒剂：消毒剂中和一粒相邻病原体后转为惰性腐殖质。
controls: Limit placement to the treatment area because STER is consumed when it neutralizes PATH.
cleanup: Allow documented treatment to consume STER, or physically remove unused treatment material.

english_description: Humus: Humus from biology treatment is recoverable into NUTR by wet composting or cooled four-module stabilization.
chinese_description: 腐殖质：生态处理产生的腐殖质可通过湿润堆肥或冷却的四模块稳定化回收为营养盐。
production: Produce HUMS through decomposition or treatment; recover it beside FERT and WATR at 285 to 315 K or in the complete waste fixture at 500 to 620 K.
uses: Recoverable biology by-product and nutrient-loop input.
hazards: Incomplete dry or out-of-window mixtures stay unchanged and may accumulate.
controls: Separate fertilizer water catalyst or companion waste; leave the registered window to stop recovery.
cleanup: Recover HUMS into NUTR or physically remove it after stabilization.

english_description: Biofilm: Fixed biofilm filters one adjacent pathogen in wet local media and preserves the water input.
chinese_description: 生物膜：固定生物膜在局部湿润介质中滤除一粒相邻病原体并保留水输入。
hazards: It only filters when local water is present.
controls: Keep BIOF dry to stop filtration, or remove it from PATH and water.
cleanup: Separate BIOF from water and PATH, then physically recover the reusable filter material.

english_description: Reactor Fuel: Moderated fuel converts to hot nuclear waste when it absorbs one local neutron outside a control rod.
chinese_description: 反应堆燃料：受慢化燃料在控制棒范围外吸收一粒局部中子后转为高温核废料。
notes: Original bounded reactor fuel rule; no upstream nuclear state machine copied.
production: Spark NGEN beside fuel and moderator while keeping CROD away.
uses: Fuel for a bounded local reactor path.
controls: Keep CROD adjacent or remove MODR and neutron input before handling NFUL.
cleanup: Stop the reactor and physically recover unreacted NFUL; converted fuel remains NWST.

english_description: Moderator: Reusable local moderator required beside reactor fuel before a neutron can trigger conversion.
chinese_description: 慢化剂：可复用的局部慢化剂；中子触发燃料转换前必须相邻存在。
production: Place MODR adjacent to NFUL before adding a neutron.
uses: Required reusable condition for fuel conversion.
hazards: It does not stop official neutron behavior.
controls: Separate MODR from NFUL or place CROD beside the fuel to suppress custom conversion.
cleanup: After neutron input stops, physically recover MODR; it is reusable in the custom route.

english_description: Control Rod: Control rod suppresses adjacent custom fuel conversion without modifying official neutron behavior.
chinese_description: 控制棒：控制棒抑制相邻自定义燃料转换，不修改官方中子行为。
production: Place CROD adjacent to the fuel reaction area.
uses: Local control for the custom fuel route.
hazards: It only suppresses the custom fuel conversion.
controls: Keep CROD adjacent to NFUL while shutdown is required; remove it only after neutron input stops.
cleanup: After neutron input stops, cool and physically recover CROD; it is not consumed by shutdown.

english_description: Reactor Coolant: High-capacity coolant turns into steam beside hot nuclear waste and removes part of its heat.
chinese_description: 反应堆冷却剂：高热容冷却剂在高温核废料旁转为蒸汽并带走部分热量。
production: Place NCLT beside hot NWST while it is below its own steam transition.
uses: Converts waste heat into official steam.
hazards: It becomes steam and leaves a hot waste particle.
controls: Limit contact to hot NWST and provide a safe path for the resulting official steam.
cleanup: Vent or condense resulting official steam safely, then cool and isolate the remaining NWST.

english_description: Nuclear Waste: Hot radioactive waste can be cooled and stabilized with SLAG HUMS POLY WATR and reusable CATA into shield and feedstock outputs.
chinese_description: 核废料：高温放射性核废料可冷却后与炉渣、腐殖质、聚合物、水和可复用催化剂稳定化为屏蔽体及原料。
production: Run the controlled fuel route; cool NWST and combine the complete waste fixture at 500 to 620 K.
uses: Recoverable reactor by-product and trigger of the four-module waste route.
hazards: Hot or incomplete mixtures remain radioactive and can ignite nearby HUMS or POLY.
controls: Stop neutron production; cool NWST and isolate it behind RSHD before bounded stabilization.
cleanup: Stabilize cooled NWST into RSHD FLUX and NUTR with retained WATR or physically isolate it.

english_description: Neutron Generator: Sparked generator emits one stationary neutron only when reactor fuel is locally present.
chinese_description: 中子发生器：通电发生器仅在局部存在反应堆燃料时发射一粒静止中子。
production: Spark NGEN beside NFUL with an empty local output slot.
uses: Controlled local neutron source for reactor experiments.
hazards: It can trigger hot fuel conversion when moderation is present.
controls: Stop electrical sparks, remove nearby NFUL, and block the local empty neutron output slot.
cleanup: Stop sparks and physically recover the generator after all local neutrons are absorbed.

english_description: Radiation Shield: Reusable shield assembled from SSIL molten LEAD and an active NCRM spark; it absorbs adjacent neutrons into limited heat.

notes: Cracker chlorine concept independently rewritten with a bounded local reaction.
production: Heat CHLR beside H2 above 450 K.
uses: Acid production input for chemistry paths.
controls: Remove heat and H2, isolate the toxic gas, and avoid creating corrosive acid.
cleanup: Consume CHLR through the registered acid path under containment, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Ammonia: Toxic ammonia made from nitrogen and hydrogen over a sparked catalyst.
chinese_description: 氨气：由氮气和氢气在通电催化剂上制备的有毒氨气。
production: Use a sparked catalyst with nitrogen hydrogen pressure and the documented temperature window.
hazards: Toxic gas reacts with acid into fertilizer.
controls: Remove catalyst sparks and pressure, isolate the toxic gas, or neutralize it through the FERT route.
cleanup: Neutralize AMON through the registered fertilizer route, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Ethanol: Flammable ethanol produced by warm yeast fermentation near plant matter and water.
chinese_description: 乙醇：由温暖酵母在植物和水附近发酵产生的易燃乙醇。
notes: Seppo token concept independently implemented as a bounded fermentation path.
production: Place yeast beside plant and water in the warm fermentation window.
hazards: It is flammable and can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and heat, separate oxidizers, and contain the flammable liquid.
cleanup: Use ETHL as registered fuel or isolate, cool, and physically remove the flammable residue.

english_description: Kerosene: Mid-range fuel made by heating oil beside a catalyst and cracked further into gasoline or acetylene.
chinese_description: 煤油：由原油在催化剂旁加热制得的中馏分燃料，可进一步裂化为汽油或乙炔。
notes: Seppo token and Cyens hydrocarbon-chain concepts independently implemented.
production: Heat CATA beside OIL above 500 K.
uses: Intermediate fuel for gasoline or acetylene routes.
hazards: It is flammable and further heating changes the product.
controls: Remove heat and catalyst contact, separate FIRE, and contain the flammable fuel.
cleanup: Process KERO through registered downstream fuel routes, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Gasoline: Volatile high-energy fuel cracked from kerosene over a catalyst.
chinese_description: 汽油：由煤油在催化剂上裂化得到的挥发性高能燃料。
notes: Seppo token and Cyens hydrocarbon-chain concepts independently implemented.
production: Heat catalyst beside kerosene above 650 K.
hazards: It is flammable and can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and heat, separate oxidizers, and contain the high-energy fuel.
cleanup: Use GASO as controlled fuel, or remove ignition sources and physically remove the residue.

english_description: Acetylene: Reactive high-energy gas made by hot catalytic cracking and polymerized by a cooler catalyst.
chinese_description: 乙炔：由高温催化裂化制得的高能反应气体，可在较冷催化剂上聚合。
notes: Cracker token concept independently implemented with bounded reactions.
production: Use a hot catalyst for cracking or a cooler catalyst for polymerisation.
hazards: Reactive flammable gas can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and hot catalyst contact, then isolate the reactive flammable gas.
cleanup: Polymerize ACTY through the registered CATA route, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Catalyst: Reusable catalyst for fuels polymers peroxide control mild slag acid treatment and cooled waste stabilization.
chinese_description: 催化剂：用于燃料、聚合、过氧化物控制、温和炉渣酸处理和冷却废物稳定化的可复用催化剂。
production: Place CATA beside registered inputs and use the required heat spark or recovery window.
uses: Reusable local catalyst for chemistry and cross-module recovery routes.
hazards: High heat corrosive acid and radioactive waste require containment.
controls: Remove heat or sparks and separate CATA from registered reagent pairs.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover CATA after reagent separation; registered reactions keep it reusable.

english_description: Polymer: Insulating polymer is made by catalytic polymerisation and is a recoverable encapsulation input for cooled four-module waste stabilization.
chinese_description: 聚合物：绝缘聚合物由催化聚合制成，也是冷却四模块废物稳定化所需的可回收封装原料。
production: Use two acetylene particles around a moderately hot catalyst or combine POLY with cooled NWST and the complete waste fixture.
uses: Insulating structure and cross-module waste encapsulation input.
hazards: Heat above 900 K can ignite POLY; missing water catalyst or companion waste leaves it unchanged.
controls: Remove heat or spark input; separate reagents and contain radioactive waste during stabilization.
cleanup: Consume POLY in the bounded RSHD route or physically recover unused polymer.

english_description: Hydrogen Peroxide: Spark-made peroxide treats PATH at 285 to 330 K; hot catalyst instead drives decomposition.
chinese_description: 过氧化氢：通电催化制得的过氧化氢可在 285 至 330 K 处理病原体；高温催化剂会使其转入分解。
production: Make PERO with sparked CATA then use it on PATH in the treatment window or decompose it beside hot CATA.
uses: Oxidizing intermediate oxygen source and biology-treatment reagent.
hazards: Hot CATA preempts treatment and decomposition can release local oxygen.
controls: Remove hot CATA or separate PERO from PATH to stop treatment; isolate oxidizers.
cleanup: Convert PATH to HUMS and WATR or decompose excess PERO under containment.

english_description: Fertilizer: Ammonia-derived fertilizer supports wet plants or recovers wet HUMS into NUTR and DUST.
chinese_description: 肥料：氨气中和酸液制得的肥料可支持湿润植物，或把湿润腐殖质回收为营养盐和尘埃。
production: Neutralize ammonia with acid then use FERT beside wet plants or wet HUMS at 285 to 315 K.
uses: Supports official plants and closes the Omni biology nutrient loop.
hazards: It is consumed into DUST during plant support or HUMS recovery.
controls: Separate FERT from WATR and HUMS or leave the composting window to stop recovery.
cleanup: Consume FERT in a controlled plant or HUMS route or physically recover unused fertilizer.

english_description: Helium: Very light inert gas with exceptional heat conduction and bounded cryogenic heat exchange below 20 K. Electrical discharge produces a pale photon glow.
chinese_description: 氦：极轻的惰性气体，导热性很高，在 20 K 以下进行有界低温换热；放电时产生淡色光子辉光。

uses: Cryogenic heat-transfer experiments and low-density inert atmospheres.
hazards: Nonflammable but its very low game temperature can rapidly cool nearby materials.
controls: Only local 3x3 checks run under the shared 1024-event-per-frame periodic budget.
cleanup: Erase or vent the gas; all emitted photons have a finite lifetime.

english_description: Francium: Extremely radioactive short-lived alkali metal proxy; it has the strongest bounded family reactions and decays to polonium with one finite photon.
chinese_description: 钫：放射性极强的短寿命碱金属代理，具有族内最强的有界反应，并衰变为钋且只发射一个有限寿命光子。
notes: Original family-generated radioactive implementation; compressed decay is explicitly game-scaled.
production: Direct placement only; every particle receives a randomized 180 to 360 tick game lifetime.
uses: Short-lived radioactive alkali reactions decay heat and shielding experiments.
hazards: Extremely radioactive and reactive; decay or wet contact produces heat pressure and a finite photon or fire.
controls: Limit sample size keep dry remove oxidizers and use shielding around every experiment.
cleanup: Contain resulting POLO vent hydrogen cool residues and wait for all finite-life photons to expire.

english_description: Oganesson: Short-lived superheavy noble-gas proxy that rapidly decays to radon with bounded heat and photon emission.
chinese_description: 鿫：短寿命超重稀有气体代理，会快速衰变为氡并产生有界热量和光子发射。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded noble-gas update.
production: Directly placeable in the unrestricted sandbox with no unlock or production prerequisite.
uses: Short-lived superheavy-element and bounded decay-chain experiments.
hazards: Extremely radioactive in the game model and unsuitable for persistent bulk storage.
controls: Only local 3x3 checks run under the shared 1024-event-per-frame periodic budget.
cleanup: Erase or vent the gas; all emitted photons have a finite lifetime.
